page.overview:
Who is Gatsby?

Commander Gatsby was a Starfleet officer that served aboard the under Captain Lisa Cusak.

Gatsby died in 2371 when the Olympia was destroyed while investigating an energy barrier around the fourth planet of a star system in the Rutharian sector. ()
